description: This Java source file defines the CreateInteropIdentifierHandler class, which handles creation of interoperation identifiers within the Fineract application. It processes a command, parses a URL, and invokes the InteropService to register an account identifier.

classes.name: CreateInteropIdentifierHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles creation of interoperation identifiers by parsing URLs and invoking interop services.

methods.name: CreateInteropIdentifierHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the InteropService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create an interoperation identifier; parses the URL, determines ID type, and calls the interop service to register the identifier.
